description: This file declares the ModemSimulator class and its interface, which manages modem services and interactions within a modem simulation environment for the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: ModemSimulator
classes.description: Main class responsible for simulating a modem, managing services, and handling commands.

methods.name: ModemSimulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the modem simulator with a given modem ID.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the modem with a channel monitor.

methods.name: DispatchCommand
methods.description: Dispatches a command from a client.

methods.name: OnFirstClientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when the first client connects.

methods.name: SaveModemState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the modem.

methods.name: IsWaitingSmsPdu
methods.description: Checks if the modem is waiting for an SMS PDU.

methods.name: IsRadioOn
methods.description: Checks if the radio is on.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the modem.

methods.name: SetPhoneNumber
methods.description: Sets the phone number for the modem.
